messages.subject: URL for Stan project
parts:
Eventually, we'll want to move to our own home page
on our own domain. Google Code's too limiting in what
your home page can look like. There are really three
things we need:

1. Code Repository (Google Code, GitHub, RForge)

2. News Groups (Google Groups, Yahoo Groups)

3. Web Site (Google Pages, ??, Columbia)

We currently use Google Code, Google Groups, and don't
have our own web pages -- we're just using the Google Code
front page.

We can do downloads either through the web site or
the code repository.

That means we need a URL. I like:

mc-stan.org

mc-stanislaw.org

both of which are available. But I haven't thought too
hard about it and would love to hear other suggestions.

- Bob
